dispositions.trace: Historical role 770 calculates padded JSON, binary and total lengths, then directly casts each to u32. At 95e, PreparedGlb::new obtains a GlbLayout before forming the packet. ChunkLayout uses checked alignment and converts each padded length with u32::try_from; GlbLayout uses checked total additions and the same conversion for the container length. PreparedGlb reserves the admitted length and writes the admitted fields; write obtains this complete packet before creating the GLB directory or writing the GLB. Length and reservation failures have explicit error variants.
dispositions.limits: This bounded writer check does not prove the entire export is side-effect-free on failure: export_rigged_glb calls texture_images.finish first, and SharedTextures can create directories or write content-addressed images before the GLB packet is prepared. Earlier buffer construction, full format correctness, concurrent filesystem behavior, successful output and other exporter paths are unassessed. No serialization, export, filesystem operation, product test or runtime probe ran.
